title: Who makes the most money from email?
html:
I’m well late with today’s MondayMotivator. No excuses, just nothing popping into my mind I wanted to write about.

However, this has been keeping my attention.

Last week I was asked this question by James Kemp, “Who makes the most money from email?”

Now, the first answer that might pop into your mind is Mailchimp. But, like me, you might think that’s too obvious so your mind will start to think about eCommerce businesses, internet marketers or even platforms like AWS or Sendgrid.

But.

That’s not the answer.

The answer is thepeople who send the most emails.

That’s right. People who send themost emails make themost money from email marketing.

It seems obvious but I missed it initially because I couldn’t see the wood for the proverbial trees. Hence a coach is a great thing to have ;)

So, I brainstormed an amazing offer to help people send more emails and convert more customers into cash.

It’s launching tomorrow morning and I’d love you to check it out. So keep an eye out for it in your inbox at 9 am.

In the meantime, think about a question a coach might ask you that you go deep on the answer because you’re not seeing the wood for the trees.

This year is going to be awesome! Let’s go!
